jobs.title: Product Manager, Core Product
jobs.description:
You'll own the roadmap for Luma's core creative product, turning frontier AI research into pro-level photo and video tools that creators love, driving adoption and setting PM best practices from day one.

This is a consumer-facing product role for someone who lives in creative workflows and can move fast with imperfect data. You'll own strategy, user research, experimentation, and launches across a fast-moving surface. If you want a mature product to optimize rather than a fast-growing one to shape, this isn't it.

What You'll Own

 - Define and execute end-to-end product strategy, translating user insight into AI-driven creative features.

 - Launch and iterate on pro-level photo and video tools, growing active users.

 - Deepen engagement through new features and agentic tools.

 - Lead cross-functional sprints, balance trade-offs, and keep a clear roadmap.

 - Run user research with professional creators to validate ideas and tune engagement loops.

 - Establish A/B testing and analytics, and partner on go-to-market for launches.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

 - Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn the product, the creators, and where activation and engagement break down.

 - Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Launch or iterate a pro tool and move an activation or engagement metric.

 - Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Set the experimentation and analytics cadence and a clear roadmap.

What You Bring

 - 5+ years shipping consumer-facing creative or editing tools (web or mobile) for professional audiences.

 - Deep expertise in photo/video workflows and UI/UX prototyping.

 - Strong analytics: defining metrics, building funnels, and iterating on retention.

 - An excellent communicator with high agency in ambiguous environments.

 - A passion for AI and integrating generative and automation tech into a roadmap.

Nice to Have

 - Experience building or growing products for creative professionals.

 - Familiarity with Figma, Canva, Adobe, or 3D/creative platforms.

 - Experience on AI-native products or in fast-moving startups.

About Luma: Luma's mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world. We believe multimodality is critical for intelligence — the next step beyond language models comes from vision. Luma is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
You'll build Luma's enterprise products from the model up, turning frontier multimodal capabilities into solutions marketing, advertising, and entertainment customers will pay for and scale. You'll operate like a general manager, making P&L-driven calls rather than executing handed-down directives.

This isn't inheriting a mature product to optimize. You'll define which customers and workflows to pursue, spend 30–40% of your time embedded with forward-deployed teams in live customer work, and build agentic products, not traditional SaaS. It needs a senior, highly autonomous PM who's genuinely AI-fluent. If you need scaffolding and clear directives, this won't fit.

What You'll Own

 - Define product opportunities across enterprise segments — customer profiles, workflows, jobs-to-be-done, and unmet needs in marketing, advertising, and entertainment.

 - Translate Luma's models, Canvas, Agents, and APIs into clear product definitions that serve real commercial customers.

 - Drive cross-functional execution across research, product, engineering, go-to-market, and forward-deployed teams in a pod structure.

 - Partner directly with enterprise customers in meetings to validate opportunities and shape direction.

 - Bridge market signals back to research so model prioritization reflects real commercial needs.

 - Build agentic products that generate revenue now and scale, operating with a GM mindset on commercial viability.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

 - Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn the models, the enterprise verticals, and the highest-value workflows.

 - Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Define and validate an enterprise product opportunity in live customer work.

 - Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Turn a bespoke win into a product that scales to more customers, with feedback loops to research.

What You Bring

 - Staff or Principal-level PM experience building enterprise products in high-ambiguity environments.

 - Built successful enterprise AI applications, especially agentic products with real adoption, not just SaaS.

 - Functional AI/ML fluency: reasoning about capabilities, evals, latency/cost trade-offs, and fine-tuning vs prompting vs tool use.

 - Effectiveness across product, engineering, research, go-to-market, and customer-facing teams.

 - A general-manager mindset with P&L experience, thinking in business trade-offs and revenue.

 - Very high agency and self-starter mentality (the top trait here), plus consultative PM skill with customers.

 - A mix of large-company and earlier-stage experience.

Nice to Have

 - Experience on multimodal model teams and products.

 - Domain exposure in marketing technology, brands, advertising, or entertainment.

 - Founder-type background.

 - Experience at enterprise AI companies (Harvey, Sierra, Decagon, Glean, Clay) where customer-embedded PM is the operating model.

 - A clear sense of the difference between a demo that wins a pitch and a product that runs in production.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
You'll own growth end to end at Luma — acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue — scaling the product from strong early traction toward mass adoption, and defining how growth works here from first principles.

Growth at Luma runs across product, engineering, marketing, and data, and you'll operate with high velocity, imperfect data, and a bias to action. It fits an experiment-driven PM who's equally strategic and hands-on. If you need clean data and an established growth function to step into, this isn't that yet.

What You'll Own

 - Own and execute product-led growth across the full funnel, from acquisition to revenue.

 - Identify and prioritize high-leverage (80/20) opportunities that drive outsized growth.

 - Design and scale rapid experimentation loops across onboarding, activation, retention, and monetization.

 - Build repeatable, measurable growth loops, and improve first-time experience so users reach value fast.

 - Partner with marketing on paid acquisition, attribution, conversion, pricing, and packaging.

 - Work hands-on with engineering to prototype, ship, and iterate, making fast decisions with limited data.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

 - Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Map the funnel, find where growth breaks, and pick the first 80/20 bets.

 - Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Run experiments across activation and monetization and land measurable wins.

 - Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Build repeatable growth loops and the experimentation cadence behind them.

What You Bring

 - 5–10+ years of product management with a strong growth focus.

 - A track record driving measurable growth (activation, retention, revenue).

 - Deep understanding of product-led growth, funnels, loops, and lifecycle optimization.

 - Strong intuition for high-leverage opportunities in ambiguous environments.

 - An experiment-driven mindset with A/B testing and rapid iteration.

 - Comfort operating strategically and tactically, with incomplete data.

 - Experience partnering with marketing on paid growth and attribution, familiarity with pricing and packaging, and the technical fluency to unblock execution.

Nice to Have

 - Experience building or growing products for creative professionals.

 - Familiarity with Figma, Canva, Adobe, or 3D/creative platforms.

 - Experience on AI-native products or in fast-moving startups.
